description: Workflow scan — verify all in-flight workflows identified and reported

rules.name: workflow_scan_complete
rules.reason: Must scan all workflow state files
rules.retry_instruction: Step-06 output is missing the 'workflows_scanned' field. Re-execute step-06 to scan all workflow/*/state.yaml files and populate this field with the count and list of workflows scanned.

rules.name: in_flight_workflows_found
rules.reason: Should identify in-flight workflows (retry if missing)
rules.retry_instruction: The 'in_flight_list' field is missing. Re-execute step-06 to identify in-flight workflows (status not 'complete') and populate this field with the list of active workflows.

rules.name: workflow_status_accurate
rules.reason: Workflow statuses should be current (warn if stale)
